title: Bablu's 4-step
items: Check your call log. Write the number down.
Example: 10 missed calls x ₹500 = ₹5,000 a week. Use your own numbers.
Make sure every call gets answered.
Voxa is an AI receptionist that answers calls 24/7/365, in 12 Indian languages, and books into Google Calendar, Outlook or Calendly.
Reply to the calls you still miss.
Missed-call text-back sends the caller an SMS the moment a call can't be answered.
footer: Setup in 4 steps: sign up and describe your business, train it on your FAQs and menu, connect your number and calendar, go live.
